note: Build-time aggregate of every public/cards/*.json wrapper (card + inclusion proof), keyed by full sha256. Exists so /api/xrpl and /api/proof read all card bodies in ONE subrequest instead of one fetch per card (Cloudflare Pages Functions cap: 50 subrequests/invocation). Copies bytes that already exist under /cards/ and /proofs/; signs nothing, measures nothing. Regenerated in build:client, so it is consistent with the root.json shipped in the same build.
